indicators.title: Search feature
indicators.description: Government portal(s) can be found on the first results page of any search engine typically used in that country

indicators.title: Help feature/FAQs section
indicators.description: A Help or 'Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)' feature available on the portal.

indicators.title: Social networking features
indicators.description: The provision of social networking feature(s) (e.g. Facebook, Twitter, YouTube, Flickr, etc.).

indicators.title: Live chat support with a person
indicators.description: The provision of "live chat" support functionality with government employees/officers in real time.

indicators.title: Privacy policy
indicators.description: Existence of a privacy policy or statement available on the MGP

indicators.title: Information on online services use
indicators.description: Guidance or tutorials to people in understanding and using online services.

indicators.title: Digital ID to access online services
indicators.description: Any kind of authentication required to access online services or restricted-access areas (e.g., digital ID; login and password; mobile key)

indicators.title: Facilitation of free Internet access
indicators.description: Information on connecting to the country’s free WIFI or statements of agreement with mobile operators

indicators.title: Access to physical spaces
indicators.description: Information on government access to physical spaces for online services

indicators.title: Open data metadata
indicators.description: The provision of relevant metadata/ dictionary about each open data file.

indicators.title: Guidance on using Open Government datasets
indicators.description: Evidence of guidance/toolkit on using Open Government datasets, helping users to better understand how to access and use open dataset

indicators.title: Mark favorite/most used online services
indicators.description: Ability to customize/personalize the national portal(s) to mark users’ favourite/most used online services

indicators.title: Co Creation/production of e-services
indicators.description: Evidence of any co creation and/or co-production of e-service (for HEALTH/ EDUCATION/ EMPLOYMENT/ SOCIAL PROTECTION/ ENVIRONMENT/ JUSTICE)
